mutations.label: routing: each branch of a Codex route has its own destination
mutations.from: when Codex is installed (`command -v codex`), `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/host-review.mjs --host codex --repo <repository root> --scope <uncommitted, commit SHA, or base REF> --requirements <text> --evidence <caller-observed JSON>`; when it is not, `/quality-harness:quality-cycle`.
mutations.to: when Codex is installed (`command -v codex`), `/quality-harness:quality-cycle`; when it is not, `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/host-review.mjs --host codex --repo <repository root> --scope <uncommitted, commit SHA, or base REF> --requirements <text> --evidence <caller-observed JSON>`.
mutations.only: ^(?:each branch of a Codex route sends the change to its own destination)$
